question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

**Timid**
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **'Timid'** describes someone who is shy and lacking in self-confidence.

 
 
• **Example:** He was always timid and dreaded public speaking.
 
 
 
• **'Fearful'** is a synonym of 'timid' and refers to someone who is frightened or afraid.
 
 
• **Example:** He was fearful of the dark.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- Option 1:** 'Fearful'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **'Bold'** (Option 2) refers to someone who is strong, confident, and courageous and is hence an antonym of 'timid'.
 
• **'Adventurous'** (Option 3) describes a person who is willing to take risks or to try out new methods, ideas, or experiences.
 
• **'Forthcoming'** (Option 4) It can mean 'about to happen or appear soon.'
